evidence_required: slot counts by category and split
explicit statement that no capture may start until the human approves
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.dependency: Human approval must be recorded later before any capture or materialization path can proceed.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat M3IL, M3IM, M3IN, or this M3IO plan as capture approval.

blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.artifact_purpose: After explicit human approval only, record per-clip consent evidence, local raw clip paths, raw clip hashes, capture-condition attestations, and withdrawal handling.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.dependency: Requires explicit human capture approval; this plan does not grant it.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.forbidden_shortcut: Do not use raw learner practice video or unapproved media as dataset capture evidence.

blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.artifact_purpose: Materialize reviewed first-party no-hand negative rows only after approval, consent/capture evidence, human/project absence-label review, no-pretrained attestations, split proof, and authoritative review receipt exist.
evidence_required: expected left and right hand presence set to false
no pretrained detector, landmark, feature, backbone, teacher output, generated label, or pseudo-label evidence
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.dependency: Requires approved capture and consent/capture receipt first.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.forbidden_shortcut: Do not create row shells, labels, tensors, or authoritative packet rows from planned_not_captured slots.

blocks: using M3IH rows as training negatives
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.artifact_purpose: Before any merge, prove M3IH validation-only rows remain excluded from training inputs and future first-party rows use a distinct row family and source mode.
evidence_required: M3IH SHA-256 unchanged or deliberate review if changed
M3IH allowed_for_training false for all 25 rows
no M3IH row ids appear in training input manifests
non_target_asl_sign context rows are not strict no-hand absence rows
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.dependency: Required before future training packet merge and before real evaluation reporting.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.forbidden_shortcut: Do not inherit training approval from validation-only challenge fixtures.

blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.artifact_purpose: Define how any future materialized first-party negatives enter prediction schema coverage, row-source accounting, strict no-hand scoring, and fixed-baseline reporting without mutating the harness yet.

blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.dependency: Can be written locally as a contract; real evaluation still requires a trained scratch Detector 0 prediction artifact.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.forbidden_shortcut: Do not run real evaluation, edit the harness, or claim model performance from synthetic smoke.

blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.artifact_purpose: After training is separately authorized and completed, report held-out hand IoU against fixed-box baselines and stop if either learned hand target fails to strictly beat the baseline.

blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.dependency: Requires future training authorization and a trained detector; this plan does not authorize either.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.forbidden_shortcut: Do not export, promote, activate, or change claims on partial metric movement or on a one-hand-only beat.

blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.artifact_purpose: Only after fixed-baseline, negative metric, browser parity, and privacy evidence pass, review whether claim surfaces may move from fail-closed.
evidence_required: no raw learner video upload proof
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.dependency: Requires passed training, real evaluation, export, browser parity, and explicit promotion receipt.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.forbidden_shortcut: Do not edit model cards, active vocabulary claims, browser gates, or final gates from planning evidence.

blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.artifact_purpose: If a future prompt requests remote training, record human approval, max runtime, max spend, kill condition, planned command, expected metric signal, and teardown rule.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.dependency: No Brev training is required or authorized by M3IO.
blocker_to_next_artifact_mapping.forbidden_shortcut: Do not start, stop, sync, exec, or copy on Brev from this plan.
